Azure.description: Azure SignalR Service backplane settings, used by the 'OrchardCore.SignalR.Azure' feature to route SignalR messages across application instances. When 'ConnectionString' is not set, a warning is logged and SignalR keeps working in single-instance mode. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/SignalR/.

ConnectionString.description: The Azure SignalR Service connection string (required), e.g. 'Endpoint=https://<your-service>.service.signalr.net;AccessKey=...;Version=1.0;'.

ApplicationName.description: An optional application name, to set to a unique value when multiple deployments share the same Azure SignalR Service. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores. A stable tenant identifier is appended so that hubs remain isolated between tenants.
